status: Complete conditional macroscopic-convention sensitivity; published microscopic extension is not identified by source data.

convention.name: TRUMOF isotropic extension, macro-only implementation
convention.tensor: Delta C_ijkl = p delta_ij delta_kl - (3p/2)(delta_ik delta_jl + delta_il delta_jk)
convention.block_changes: Delta D = V p SOURCE_DELTA; Delta K = 0; Delta strain-displacement coupling = 0
convention.Gamma_variable_cell: same K and coupling; pressure-convention homogeneous strain block D
convention.Bloch_finite_k: unchanged by the minimal macro-only diagnostic; NOT a source-derived microscopic correction
convention.acoustic_delta: Delta Q(n)=-1.5p I-0.5p n n^T for unit n
convention.acoustic_small_q_required_if_dynamically: Delta H_ac(q)=(V/N)[-1.5p |q|^2 I-0.5p q q^T]+o(|q|^2) for equal nodal displacement normalization
convention.ambiguity: Cubic data do not determine anisotropic structure-dependent terms, local interpolation, optical Gamma blocks, or finite-k corrections. Shear data alone do not determine Delta C11 and Delta C12. The chosen isotropic extension fits all three checked cubic combinations.
convention.implication: PD+LE for published rows concerns the pressure-convention tensor. It is not simultaneous instability of the unchanged microscopic acoustic spectrum. A unique physical published first-instability table cannot be inferred without another microscopic prescription.

calibration.mof5_reference_distance_status: 13.0 A explicitly chosen; supplied sources do not specify the numerical GULP reference distance or spring constants
calibration.angular_counting: all 15 unordered pairs of the six neighbours per node, including collinear pairs

precision_check.classification_method: Simple PD null strain: sym(a tensor n) compatibility; no absolute 1e-5 GPa LE rounding.
